_comment: Declarative manifest of Azure resources this fleet's infra code ASSUMES exist. Consumed by setup/resource-reconcile.mjs. Populated by grepping actual references in setup/heartbeat-registry.json, setup/deploy-gate-check.mjs, and skills/decision-clock/cosmos-client.mjs -- every name below is something live code already calls by that exact name, not an invented target. If you add a new job/vault/registry/identity/storage-account reference anywhere in this repo, add it here too, or resource-reconcile.mjs cannot catch it going absent.

resources.name: ring-memory-index-daily
resources.note: THE incident resource -- provision-ring-memory-job.yml is workflow_dispatch-only; if nobody clicks Run this job silently does not exist. This is exactly the failure mode A6-RESOURCE-CI exists to catch.

resources.name: decision-clock
resources.note: Canonical decision-clock (heartbeat-wrapped, managed-identity/Key-Vault env). The legacy duplicate decision-clock-sweep (dead GCP env, unmonitored, same cron 15 23) was retired 2026-07-13 (deleted from ARM + this manifest).

resources.name: fleet-medic
resources.note: Real-time Team Medic auto-dispatch (cron */30). Was 'claimed-deployed but absent' in stale memory; live ARM confirms it exists + Succeeded. Tracked here so it cannot silently go dark unnoticed.

resources.name: cfo-reconstruction-nightly
resources.note: Tier-1 nightly CFO financial-reconstruction ANALYSIS (cron 10 8). Read-only Xero via xero-readonly.mjs allowlist; stages to the CFO data room reconstruction-analysis/ prefix; never posts. Managed-identity (id-otc-jobs-kv) auth, no secrets. First run 2026-07-17 Succeeded (staged batch_fd57a782db0e9179.json).

resources.name: kv-otc-55c84f6bef
resources.note: every job's runtime secrets (Cosmos, storage, Xero, OpenAI, etc.) resolve from this vault via skills/kb-memory/azure-secret.mjs. If it goes missing, effectively every job breaks.

resources.name: id-otc-jobs-kv
resources.note: grants jobs Key Vault Secrets User + AcrPull; jobs authenticate at runtime via this identity (see skills/kb-memory/azure-secret.mjs identityToken() path).

resources.name: otchealthcommons
resources.note: fleet commons blob store (heartbeat beats, company-journal, shared memory). Resource group not referenced anywhere in this repo's ARM calls (only data-plane blob URLs are used) -- REVIEWER: fill in resourceGroup once confirmed, or resource-reconcile.mjs will do a subscription-wide resource search instead of an RG-scoped GET for this entry.

resources.name: otchealthcfodata
resources.note: resourceGroup unconfirmed, same caveat as otchealthcommons.

resources.name: otchealthlegalstore
resources.note: resourceGroup unconfirmed, same caveat as otchealthcommons.

resources.name: otchealthcommerce
resources.note: resourceGroup unconfirmed, same caveat as otchealthcommons.

resources.name: cosmos-otc-agentstate-55c84
resources.note: shared agent-state Cosmos account (db 'agent-state', container 'decisions_pending' among others) used by decision-clock and the gateway. resourceGroup not referenced in this repo -- REVIEWER: fill in once confirmed.
